bio: This extremely popular place boasts fresh and flavoursome cuisine in the form of a short menu that changes with the seasons. Tables without tablecloths, wooden floorboards and partly exposed brick walls, as well as appealing wine-themed decorative details make for a cosy bistro feel with a rustic touch. The service is laid-back, friendly and attentive. The chef also gets in on the action front of house, providing charming service and excellent wine recommendations. There's also a great beer garden!...
